config.decoder_evaluation: float64 mathematical T_beta of measured conditionals; actual generation follows pinned float32 logits/softmax
config.fresh_definition: 75 distinct human sequences of length131 per generation, each used in one optimizer step: 9750 actual next-token labels. Other75 steps use generated sequences. Every arm keeps150 updates and19500 target exposures.
config.stopping: All285 condition-generations, including45 no-training generations; no significance or collapse-triggered early stop. Resource pauses retain checkpoints and the full horizon.

warm_intervention_reuse.reason: Identical model, corpus, contexts, initialization, generation/training random numbers,150 updates and15-generation horizon. Temperature is the warm intervention.

seed_design: Independent seeds within each setting; near_cool is also independent of near_warm. Warm/collapse/fresh/no-training seed1..3 are deliberately matched across conditions. Do not pool across conditions or dependent generations.

collapse_criterion.confirmation_generation: second consecutive measured generation at or below the threshold
collapse_criterion.boundary: conditional effective support, not literal vocabulary extinction

forecasts.scope: No parameter update. Constant untempered and decoder entropies; realized finite samples vary.

response_model.equation: x=logit(H/log(V)); x_next=x+c0+c1*b+c2*(x-x0), with optional declared additional feature; b=(beta-beta_c)/.05; H_next=log(V)*expit(x_next)
response_model.model_selection: Eligibility: nonincreasing beta response and nonexpansive state update over .95..1.15. Minimize sum of three held-out entropy MSEs; within 10% prefer fewer terms.

uncertainty.unit: complete seed trajectories; stratified three-seed parameter bootstrap plus nearest-setting centered full 15-step residual blocks
uncertainty.nominal: model-based pointwise 95% and whole-curve sup-error band; empirical coverage and beta extrapolation remain unverified
uncertainty.fresh_assumption: same residual block, scaled by synthetic training fraction; mean fresh contribution restores the initial entropy coordinate

response_model.fresh_mechanism_assumption: At50% fresh optimizer steps the proposed response model replaces half the synthetic latent-coordinate update with restoration to the initial entropy coordinate. This is unvalidated and may fail.

primary_near_rule: Both five-seed trajectory-mean D_H Student-t95 intervals exclude zero in their frozen directions. Also report the inherited warmer2SE/cooler-sign rule and both-arm2SE rule separately.
collapse_rule: Each of the3 collapse seeds has two consecutive H<=log(8) by generation15. The three-seed mean confirmation generation must lie in the predeclared guarded timing band[4, 14]. Central prediction and bootstrap-only interval are reported separately. No arm-dependent threshold or interval changes.
intervention_rule: All3 matched seeds in each of warm and fresh have H>log(8) at every generation1..15. Report every trajectory and any threshold violation.
curve_rule: For each trained logical condition, the observed seed-mean H path lies inside the frozen simultaneous H envelope at every generation. Report pointwise and complete-path coverage separately; no nominal coverage guarantee under extrapolation.
control_rule: All no-training parameter tensors remain equal to their initial values, untempered H and decoder H remain constant to1e-8; report realized sample entropies and their variation.

interpretation_hierarchy.name: instrument validity
interpretation_hierarchy.requires: all285 generations, source/checkpoint/seed/budget/prefix checks pass; otherwise scientific verdict is blocked

interpretation_hierarchy.name: near signs
interpretation_hierarchy.requires: both five-seed t95 intervals; describe all weaker rule outcomes separately

interpretation_hierarchy.name: actual conditional-entropy collapse
interpretation_hierarchy.requires: fixed threshold met by all3 collapse seeds; mean confirmation timing compared with frozen band

interpretation_hierarchy.name: prevention at fixed horizon
interpretation_hierarchy.requires: collapse occurs and both matched interventions stay above threshold in every seed

interpretation_hierarchy.name: laboratory predicts-and-prevents claim
interpretation_hierarchy.requires: levels0..3 plus all trained logical-condition complete-curve envelopes and no-training control pass
interpretation_hierarchy.authorized_text: On this fixed Qwen7B/WikiText laboratory protocol, the precommitted response model predicted an observed conditional-entropy threshold crossing and both interventions prevented that crossing through generation15.
interpretation_hierarchy.excluded: Universal neural law, exact critical beta, field priority, public benchmark victory and quality preservation are not authorized.

rate_measurements.fixed_base_KL: separate exact singleton-family radius; not the global adapter radius
rate_measurements.base_direction_fit: coefficient plus full-vector mismatch; not theorem eta
rate_measurements.sequence: After S54, check the real-loop rate/optimization interfaces against these actual hypotheses; do not substitute an entropy coefficient.
